body.p: In the beginning Evenki people were dancing. Korendo is coming. Korendo came and ate the Evenki people. One old woman was left back, [Korendo] didn't eat. The old woman was alone, she started to live. Korendo ate the Evenki people and flew off. Then the old woman made herself a son out of goose excrements, she raised and raised [him], he became a human.[DCh]: Not clear whether the root "mu-" is indeed a variant of "ÉmÉ-". Then they forged an iron [armor]. He was forging and forging in order to chase Korendo, in order to fly off. His name [was] Unyanmi. Then he started to chase Korendo, he was chasing [him]. He found Korendo, who had eaten the Evenki people. There he tore his [= Korendo's] belly. After he has torn [it], the Evenki people came out, they came out of his belly. Korendo was now killed by Unyani. Then the Evenki people, some of them died, the eaten ones died. Then he took the Evenki people out of the belly. Then he headed back, he flew off. Then he came, he came by foot.[DCh]: The analysis of "Å¡urudÊ¼aktikiwi" is quite unclear.
